title: privilege-curation-and-evidence-pipeline-for-jurisdictional-compliance
creator: Anjali Kapoor
description: Build an end-to-end pipeline that curates least-privilege RBAC assignments scoped by customer data residency and generates cryptographically verifiable evidence bundles for periodic access reviews and audits. This ticket covers the orchestration layer: SCIM-driven provisioning and deprovisioning rules, SAML/SSO session tagging with residency claims, scheduled access snapshot exporter, signed evidence package format, and retention controls ensuring evidence and raw logs obey jurisdictional retention policies.
acceptance_criteria: SCIM provisioning accepts and enforces 'residency_scope' attribute and maps to tenant-scoped roles
SAML assertion contains residency claim and the Console uses it to enforce RBAC scoping for sessions
Scheduled snapshot exporter produces per-tenant signed evidence bundles (GZIP + detached signature) with configurable retention label
Evidence bundles are stored to configured customer-residency buckets and lifecycle rules apply (retention/ttl)
UI: Compliance > Access Reviews shows last snapshot time, diff against previous snapshot, and a link to the signed bundle
Automated periodic review job can flag high-risk accounts (privileged + last_active > 90d) and create follow-up tasks
implementation_notes: Add 'residency_scope' column to identity_users and scim_mappings (nullable for legacy tenants). Backfill strategy: tenant-by-tenant using residency metadata service
SCIM: extend provisioning endpoints to accept custom schema extension urn:redwood:residency and map to role templates during create/patch
SAML: include 'acr:residency' claim in identity provider mapping; Console performs claim validation on login and binds session to residency-scoped authorization cache

Snapshot exporter: airflow DAG (or K8s CronJob) to produce deterministic, versioned JSON snapshots, compress and sign with KMS asymmetric key; metadata manifest should include generator version and hash
Evidence storage: use per-region buckets with replication disabled when tenant residency requires single-region residency; bucket lifecycle enforces retention TTL, and deletion events feed audit log
Telemetry: emit events for provisioning changes, snapshot generation success/failure, evidence upload, and retention expirations; add observability to Console compliance dashboard
Rollout: feature-flag SCIM residency enforcement per-tenant; staged rollout to low-risk customers then expanded after 2 weeks of metrics stability
updates: 2026-02-22: Initial design synced with PM and Legal. Legal asked for detached signatures and proof-of-origin metadata in bundles.
2026-02-28: Spike completed for SCIM extension. PoC shows mapping to role templates works; edge case for group-scoped roles needs follow-up.
2026-03-03: Security review kickoff scheduled. Raised question about KMS key residency for signing - security recommends HSM-backed keys in customer region for high-residency tenants.
2026-03-06: Implemented snapshot exporter prototype (k8s cron). Generated first signed bundle for staging tenant. Upload to eu-west-1 bucket succeeded.
2026-03-09: UX wireframes uploaded and reviewed by Design. Requested clearer explanation of 'evidence retention' on the review page and an action to request extended retention exports.
2026-03-10: PR opened for SCIM API changes: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4218. CI failing on serialization tests; working through JSON schema compatibility for older SCIM clients.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: SCIM clients may not send residency attribute -> Mitigation: allow manual tenant-level residency override in Console and run a reconciliation job
Risk: Evidence stored in wrong region -> Mitigation: enforce server-side bucket policy checks and preflight validations during upload
Risk: Signing key compromise -> Mitigation: use HSM-backed KMS keys, rotate keys quarterly, and include key-identifier in bundle manifest
Risk: Large tenants snapshot size causing exporter timeouts -> Mitigation: stream snapshot generation and produce incremental deltas; add exporter autoscaling
qa_plan: Unit tests for SCIM schema extension and SAML claim parsing
End-to-end test using a staging tenant with residency eu-west-1: provision user via SCIM, sign in via SAML, generate snapshot, verify bundle signature and storage location
Chaos test: simulate snapshot exporter partial failure and verify retry/backoff and alerting
Manual review: Legal reviews generated evidence bundle for required metadata and signature format
